name: sarvm
description: A language for programs that reason under uncertainty: probabilistic control flow, first-class tensors, capability security, provenance tracking, and contracts that generate their own tests.

scripts.examples: node bin/sarvm.mjs run examples/quantum.sarvm && node bin/sarvm.mjs run examples/agents.sarvm && node bin/sarvm.mjs run examples/devices.sarvm && node bin/sarvm.mjs run examples/crypto.sarvm --grant crypto
